from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

def main():

    output=Path(args.output).resolve();output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    assert not output.exists(),output
    raw=output.open("w",buffering=1);lock=threading.Lock()
    def emit(event,**kw):
        with lock:raw.write(json.dumps(dict(event=event,utc=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ",time.gmtime()),**kw))+"\n")
    tok=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model);config=AutoConfig.from_pretrained(args.model)
    prompts=[tok(text).input_ids for text in ("The capital of France is","What is 2 plus 2?","Write a short greeting.","Linux is")]
    modes=("kernel","userspace");matrix=((1,1),(64,1),(1,8),(64,8));repetitions=1 if args.correctness else 5
    emit("metadata",model=args.model,vocab=config.vocab_size,prompts=prompts,precision="fp16",
         modes=modes,matrix=matrix,repetitions=repetitions,requests_per_cell=64,warmups_per_executor=8,
         correctness=args.correctness,trace_condition="both transports identically BF_TRACE",
         commit=subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip(),
         driver_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),client_source=(root/"bench/resident_dispatch.py").read_text(),
         backend_source=(root/"executor/vllm_graph.py").read_text(),native_source=(root/"executor/vllm_graph.cu").read_text(),
         python=sys.version,torch=subprocess.check_output(["python3","-c","import torch;print(torch.__version__)"],text=True).strip())
    exit_code=1
    try:

                assert not Path("/sys/module/bfusion_tx").exists()
                assert not Path("/sys/fs/bpf/bpfusion_ctl").exists()
                p=None;attached=False;rows=[];success=False

                trace=Path(str(prefix)+".gpu.jsonl");logpath=Path(str(prefix)+".stdout.txt")
                nettrace=Path(str(prefix)+".network.txt")
                budget=2048 if args.correctness else 264

                    args.model,"300","--trace-output",str(trace),"--trace-requests",str(budget)]
                if args.correctness:command=["strace","-D","-f","-e","trace=network,write","-o",str(nettrace),*command]
                try:

                        emit("attach",pair=pair,mode=mode,code=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr)
                        assert r.returncode==0;attached=True
                    with logpath.open("w") as log:p=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
                    emit("start",pair=pair,mode=mode,pid=p.pid,command=command,trace=str(trace))
                    print(f"START pair={pair} mode={mode} pid={p.pid}",flush=True)
                    while "resident vLLM ready" not in logpath.read_text():
                        if p.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError(logpath.read_text()[-6000:])
                        time.sleep(.1)
                    emit("ready",pair=pair,mode=mode,pid=p.pid)
                    def keep(row,kind):
                        row=dict(row,kind=kind);rows.append(row)

                    def wire(ids,gen,http=True):

                        body=(f"POST /generate HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nContent-Length: {len(payload)}\r\n\r\n".encode()+payload) if http else payload
                        return marker,body
                    def receive(client,ids,gen,marker,http=True,bad=False):

                            while not head.endswith(b"\r\n\r\n"):

                        elif bad:

                            chunk=client.recv(count-len(data));assert chunk,"short body";data+=chunk
                        tokens=list(struct.unpack(f"<{count//4}I",data))
                        return dict(client_ns=marker,input_ids=ids,gen=gen,bad=bad,tokens=tokens,http=http)
                    def exchange(ids,gen,kind,http=True,split=False,bad=False,client=None):

                        try:
                            marker,data=wire(ids,gen,http)

                            else:client.sendall(data)

                        finally:
                            if own:client.close()
                    if args.correctness:
                        for _ in range(5000):connect().close()
                        emit("empty_connections",pair=pair,mode=mode,count=5000)
                        cases=prompts+[(prompts[0]*math.ceil(n/len(prompts[0])))[:n] for n in (1,15,16,17,32,64)]
                        for repeat in range(3):

                            barrier=threading.Barrier(count)

                                        if reject:
                                            invalid=ids.copy();invalid[0]=config.vocab_size
                                            exchange(invalid,gen,kind+"_reject",bad=True,client=client)
                                        exchange(ids,gen,kind,client=client)
                            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=count) as pool:
                                futures=[pool.submit(lane,i) for i in range(count)]
                                for future in futures:future.result()
                        # Every client concurrency count is exercised; report actual GPU batches.
                        for count in range(1,9):concurrent(count,1,"concurrency_"+str(count))
                        concurrent(8,32,"wrap",reject=True)
                        concurrent(8,4,"mixed",mixed=True)
                        with connect() as client:
                            sent=[]
                            for i in range(6):
                                ids=cases[i%len(cases)];marker,data=wire(ids,64);client.sendall(data);sent.append((ids,marker))
                            client.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)
                            for ids,marker in sent:keep(receive(client,ids,64,marker),"pipeline_halfclose")
                        bad_last=prompts[0].copy();bad_last[-1]=config.vocab_size

                        with connect() as client:
                            sent=[]

                                marker,data=wire(ids,64);client.sendall(data);sent.append((ids,marker,bad))
                            for ids,marker,bad in sent:keep(receive(client,ids,64,marker,bad=bad),"pipeline_reject")
                        exchange(bad_first,64,"binary_reject",http=False,bad=True)
                        exchange(prompts[0],64,"after_reject",http=False)
                    else:
                        with connect() as client:
                            for i in range(8):
                                ids=prompts[i%len(prompts)]
                                keep(dict(request(client,ids,None,gen=1),input_ids=ids,gen=1,bad=False),"warmup")
                        for gen,concurrency in matrix:
                            barrier=threading.Barrier(concurrency+1);ready=threading.Barrier(concurrency+1)
                            selected=[]
                            def lane(i):
                                with connect() as client:
                                    ready.wait(timeout=60);barrier.wait(timeout=60)
                                    for index in range(i,64,concurrency):
                                        ids=prompts[index%len(prompts)]
                                        row=dict(request(client,ids,None,gen=gen),input_ids=ids,gen=gen,bad=False,index=index,concurrency=concurrency)
                                        selected.append(row)
                            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=concurrency) as pool:
                                futures=[pool.submit(lane,i) for i in range(concurrency)]
                                ready.wait(timeout=60);barrier.wait(timeout=60)
                                for future in futures:future.result()
                            first=min(row["start_ns"] for row in selected);last=max(row["arrival_ns"][-1] for row in selected)
                            for row in selected:keep(row,"measured")
                            emit("cell",pair=pair,mode=mode,gen=gen,concurrency=concurrency,
                                requests=64,tokens=64*gen,first_ns=first,last_ns=last,output_tokens_per_s=64*gen/((last-first)/1e9))
                    if args.correctness:
                        tids=[int(t.name) for t in Path(f"/proc/{p.pid}/task").iterdir() if int(t.name)!=p.pid]
                        assert tids
                        ret=ctypes.CDLL(None).tgkill(p.pid,tids[0],signal.SIGTERM);assert ret==0

                    else:p.terminate()
                    code=p.wait();log=logpath.read_text()
                    emit("executor",pair=pair,mode=mode,exit_code=code,stdout=log)
                    assert code==0 and "graph_error=0" in log and "launches=1 " in log,log[-6000:]
                    refs=[json.loads(line) for line in Path(str(trace)+".references.jsonl").open()]
                    assert len(rows)==len(refs),(len(rows),len(refs))
                    by_marker={row["client_ns"]:row for row in refs};assert len(by_marker)==len(refs)
                    checked=0
                    for row in rows:
                        ref=by_marker.pop(row["client_ns"])
                        assert ref["prompt"]==row["input_ids"] and ref["gen"]==row["gen"] and bool(ref["bad"])==row["bad"],(row,ref)
                        assert ref["tokens"]==row["tokens"],(row,ref)
                        checked+=len(row["tokens"])
                    assert not by_marker
                    events=[json.loads(line) for line in trace.open()]
                    assert events[-1]["overflows"]==0
                    batches=sorted({e["batch"] for e in events if e["event"]=="compute"})
                    queries=sorted({e["query"] for e in events if e["event"]=="compute"})
                    emit("verified",pair=pair,mode=mode,requests=len(rows),tokens=checked,
                        rejections=sum(row["bad"] for row in rows),actual_batches=batches,actual_queries=queries,reference_path=str(trace)+".references.jsonl")
                    if args.correctness:
                        network=nettrace.read_text();assert "resident vLLM ready" in network
                        active=network.split("resident vLLM ready",1)[1]
                        calls=r"\b(?:accept4?|recvfrom|recvmsg|recvmmsg|sendto|sendmsg|sendmmsg)\("
                        if mode=="kernel":assert not re.search(calls,active),active
                        else:
                            for call in ("accept4","recvfrom","sendmsg"):assert re.search(r"\b"+call+r"\(",active),call
                        emit("network_verified",pair=pair,mode=mode,trace_path=str(nettrace))
                    if mode=="kernel":
                        r=subprocess.run(["./build/bpfusion_load","stats"],capture_output=True,text=True)
                        emit("stats",pair=pair,mode=mode,code=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0
                    assert not Path("/sys/module/bfusion_tx").exists()
                    print(f"PASS pair={pair} mode={mode} requests={len(rows)} tokens={checked} batches={batches}",flush=True)
                    success=True

                    if p is not None and p.poll() is None:p.terminate();emit("cleanup_executor",pair=pair,mode=mode,exit_code=p.wait())
                    if attached:
                        r=subprocess.run(["./build/bpfusion_load","stream-detach"],capture_output=True,text=True)
                        emit("detach",pair=pair,mode=mode,code=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr)
                        for name in ("bpfusion_ctl","bpfusion_stats","bpfusion_db"):Path("/sys/fs/bpf",name).unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    emit("executor_terminal",pair=pair,mode=mode,success=success)

    except BaseException as exc:
        emit("failure",kind=type(exc).__name__,message=str(exc),traceback=traceback.format_exc());traceback.print_exc()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Matched HF graph dispatch/network controls on the token HTTP path."""
import argparse
import ctypes
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import socket
import statistics
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time

sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/"tests"))
from resident_qwen import oracle_cases


def command(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(args,text=True,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).strip()


def cpu_seconds(pid):
    fields=Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat").read_text().rsplit(") ",1)[1].split()
    return (int(fields[11])+int(fields[12]))/os.sysconf("SC_CLK_TCK")


_libc=ctypes.CDLL(None)
_libc.clock_getcpuclockid.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int)]
_libc.clock_getcpuclockid.restype=ctypes.c_int


def worker_cpu_snapshot(pid):
    # POSIX process CPU clock includes all executor threads. TX uses the
    # kernel scheduler's adjusted task accounting, exposed read-only.
    # Neither counter attributes RX/softirq, BPF execution or all TCP work.
    begin=time.monotonic_ns()
    clock=ctypes.c_int()
    error=_libc.clock_getcpuclockid(pid,ctypes.byref(clock))
    if error: raise OSError(error,os.strerror(error))
    process=time.clock_gettime_ns(clock.value)
    tx_path=Path("/sys/module/bfusion_tx/parameters/tx_cpu_ns")
    tx=int(tx_path.read_text()) if Path("/sys/module/bfusion_tx").exists() else 0
    return {"sample_begin_ns":begin,"sample_end_ns":time.monotonic_ns(),
            "executor_cpu_ns":process,"kernel_tx_cpu_ns":tx}


def worker_cpu_delta(before,after):
    process=after["executor_cpu_ns"]-before["executor_cpu_ns"]
    tx=after["kernel_tx_cpu_ns"]-before["kernel_tx_cpu_ns"]
    assert process>=0 and tx>=0,(before,after)
    return {"worker_cpu_before":before,"worker_cpu_after":after,
            "executor_clock_cpu_ns":process,"kernel_tx_cpu_ns":tx,
            "known_worker_cpu_ns":process+tx}


def host_cpu_ticks():
    # Global host counters include clients, kernel work and other workloads.
    return [int(value) for value in Path("/proc/stat").read_text().splitlines()[0].split()[1:]]


def gpu_state():
    return command("nvidia-smi","--query-gpu=timestamp,name,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,temperature.gpu,power.draw,utilization.gpu","--format=csv,noheader,nounits")


def request(client,ids,expected,gen=None):
    # A dynamic-batch backend validates against independent trajectory replay.
    if expected is not None: gen=len(expected)
    assert isinstance(gen,int) and gen>0
    client_ns=time.monotonic_ns()
    body=struct.pack("<IIIIQ",0x514c4d51,len(ids),gen,0,client_ns)+struct.pack(f"<{len(ids)}I",*ids)
    wire=f"POST /generate HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nContent-Length: {len(body)}\r\n\r\n".encode()+body
    start=time.monotonic_ns()
    client.sendall(wire)
    header=b""; data=b""; arrivals=[]
    while len(data)<4*gen:
        chunk=client.recv(4096)
        arrived=time.monotonic_ns()
        assert chunk,"short reply"
        if header is not None:
            header+=chunk
            if b"\r\n\r\n" not in header: continue
            head,chunk=header.split(b"\r\n\r\n",1)
            assert head.startswith(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n"),head
            assert f"Content-Length: {4*gen}".encode() in head,head
            header=None
        data+=chunk
        arrivals.extend([arrived]*((len(data)//4)-len(arrivals)))
    assert len(data)==4*gen,data
    actual=list(struct.unpack(f"<{gen}I",data))
    if expected is not None: assert actual==expected,(ids,actual,expected)
    return {"client_ns":client_ns,"start_ns":start,"arrival_ns":arrivals,"tokens":actual,
            "ttft_ms":(arrivals[0]-start)/1e6,
            "latency_ms":(arrivals[-1]-start)/1e6,
            "tpot_ms":(arrivals[-1]-arrivals[0])/(gen-1)/1e6 if gen>1 else None}


def connect():
    client=socket.create_connection((os.environ.get("BF_BIND","127.0.0.1"),39403),timeout=60)
    client.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP,socket.TCP_NODELAY,1)
    return client


def cell(pid,cases,gen,concurrency,count,rows):
    # Connections and thread creation precede both the timer and CPU window.
    barrier=threading.Barrier(concurrency+1)
    ready=threading.Barrier(concurrency+1)
    def worker(worker_id):
        with connect() as client:
            ready.wait(timeout=60)
            barrier.wait(timeout=60)
            for index in range(worker_id,count,concurrency):
                case=index%len(cases); ids,expected=cases[case]
                row=request(client,ids,expected[:gen]); row.update(index=index,case=case)
                rows.append(row)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=concurrency) as pool:
        futures=[pool.submit(worker,i) for i in range(concurrency)]
        ready.wait(timeout=60)
        before=cpu_seconds(pid); host_before=host_cpu_ticks(); worker_before=worker_cpu_snapshot(pid); start=time.monotonic_ns()
        barrier.wait(timeout=60)
        for future in futures: future.result()
        finish=time.monotonic_ns(); worker_after=worker_cpu_snapshot(pid); host_after=host_cpu_ticks(); after=cpu_seconds(pid)
    first=min(row["start_ns"] for row in rows)
    last=max(row["arrival_ns"][-1] for row in rows)
    return {
        "window_ns":finish-start,"executor_cpu_s":after-before,
        **worker_cpu_delta(worker_before,worker_after),
        "host_cpu_ticks_before":host_before,"host_cpu_ticks_after":host_after,
        "host_cpu_work_s":sum(host_after[i]-host_before[i] for i in (0,1,2,5,6))/os.sysconf("SC_CLK_TCK"),
        "output_tokens_per_s":count*gen/((last-first)/1e9)}


def analyze(path):
    records=[json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]
    meta=next(row for row in records if row["event"]=="metadata")
    cells=[row for row in records if row["event"]=="cell"]
    samples=[row for row in records if row["event"]=="request"]
    expected_cells=meta["repetitions"]*len(meta["executors"])*len(meta["matrix"])
    assert len(cells)==expected_cells,(len(cells),expected_cells)
    assert len(samples)==expected_cells*meta["requests_per_cell"]
    assert len([row for row in records if row["event"]=="executor"])==len(meta["executors"])*meta["repetitions"]
    for row in samples:
        assert row["tokens"]==meta["cases"][row["case"]][1][:row["gen"]],row
        assert row["ttft_ms"]==(row["arrival_ns"][0]-row["start_ns"])/1e6,row
    for block in cells:
        selected=[row for row in samples if all(row[key]==block[key] for key in ("pair","mode","gen","concurrency"))]
        assert sorted(row["index"] for row in selected)==list(range(meta["requests_per_cell"])),block
    def percentile(values,q):
        ordered=sorted(values); pos=(len(ordered)-1)*q
        low=math.floor(pos); high=math.ceil(pos)
        return ordered[low]+(ordered[high]-ordered[low])*(pos-low)
    modes=tuple(meta["executors"])
    for gen,concurrency in meta["matrix"]:
        pair_means={}
        for mode in modes:
            selected=[row for row in samples if row["mode"]==mode and row["gen"]==gen and row["concurrency"]==concurrency]
            selected_cells=[row for row in cells if row["mode"]==mode and row["gen"]==gen and row["concurrency"]==concurrency]
            ttft=[row["ttft_ms"] for row in selected]
            tpot=[row["tpot_ms"] for row in selected if row["tpot_ms"] is not None]
            pair_means[mode]=[statistics.mean(row["ttft_ms"] for row in selected if row["pair"]==pair) for pair in range(meta["repetitions"])]
            print(json.dumps({"mode":mode,"gen":gen,"concurrency":concurrency,"requests":len(selected),
                "ttft_mean_ms":statistics.mean(ttft),"ttft_p50_ms":percentile(ttft,.5),"ttft_p99_ms":percentile(ttft,.99),
                "tpot_mean_ms":statistics.mean(tpot) if tpot else None,
                "completion_mean_ms":statistics.mean(row["latency_ms"] for row in selected),
                "host_cpu_work_s_per_cell":[row.get("host_cpu_work_s") for row in selected_cells],
                "executor_cpu_s_per_cell":[row["executor_cpu_s"] for row in selected_cells],
                "known_worker_cpu_ns_per_cell":[row.get("known_worker_cpu_ns") for row in selected_cells],
                "kernel_tx_cpu_ns_per_cell":[row.get("kernel_tx_cpu_ns") for row in selected_cells],
                "tokens_per_s":[row["output_tokens_per_s"] for row in selected_cells]}))
        for control in modes[1:]:
            differences=[host-resident for host,resident in zip(pair_means[control],pair_means["resident"])]
            mean=statistics.mean(differences)
            # Five independent paired process blocks; Student t, df=4, two-sided 95%.
            margin=2.776445105*statistics.stdev(differences)/math.sqrt(5) if len(differences)==5 else None
            print(json.dumps({"control":control,"gen":gen,"concurrency":concurrency,("paired_host_minus_resident_ttft_ms" if control=="host-launch" else "paired_user_network_minus_resident_ttft_ms"):differences,
                "difference_mean_ms":mean,"difference_t95_ms":[mean-margin,mean+margin] if margin is not None else None}))
            differences=[next(row["output_tokens_per_s"] for row in cells if row["pair"]==pair and row["mode"]=="resident" and row["gen"]==gen and row["concurrency"]==concurrency)-
                         next(row["output_tokens_per_s"] for row in cells if row["pair"]==pair and row["mode"]==control and row["gen"]==gen and row["concurrency"]==concurrency) for pair in range(meta["repetitions"])]
            mean=statistics.mean(differences)
            margin=2.776445105*statistics.stdev(differences)/math.sqrt(5) if len(differences)==5 else None
            print(json.dumps({"control":control,"gen":gen,"concurrency":concurrency,("paired_resident_minus_host_tps" if control=="host-launch" else "paired_resident_minus_user_network_tps"):differences,
                "difference_mean_tps":mean,"difference_t95_tps":[mean-margin,mean+margin] if margin is not None else None}))
            if all("known_worker_cpu_ns" in row for row in cells):
                differences=[next(row["known_worker_cpu_ns"] for row in cells if row["pair"]==pair and row["mode"]==control and row["gen"]==gen and row["concurrency"]==concurrency)-
                             next(row["known_worker_cpu_ns"] for row in cells if row["pair"]==pair and row["mode"]=="resident" and row["gen"]==gen and row["concurrency"]==concurrency) for pair in range(meta["repetitions"])]
                mean=statistics.mean(differences)
                margin=2.776445105*statistics.stdev(differences)/math.sqrt(5) if len(differences)==5 else None
                divisor=meta["requests_per_cell"]*1000
                print(json.dumps({"control":control,"gen":gen,"concurrency":concurrency,
                    "paired_control_minus_resident_worker_cpu_us_per_request":[value/divisor for value in differences],
                    "difference_mean_worker_cpu_us_per_request":mean/divisor,
                    "difference_t95_worker_cpu_us_per_request":[(mean-margin)/divisor,(mean+margin)/divisor] if margin is not None else None}))


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Bootstrap upstream vLLM graphs; native GPU owns online request execution."""
import argparse,ctypes,json,math,os,sys
from pathlib import Path
import torch
OriginalGraph=torch.cuda.CUDAGraph
class KeptGraph(OriginalGraph):
    def __new__(cls,keep_graph=False):return super().__new__(cls,True)
    def __init__(self,keep_graph=False):super().__init__(True)
torch.cuda.CUDAGraph=KeptGraph
from vllm import LLM
from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.cudagraph_utils import ModelCudaGraphManager,BatchExecutionDescriptor
from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.gumbel import gumbel_sample

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("model");ap.add_argument("seconds",type=int,nargs="?",default=60)
    ap.add_argument("--trace-output");ap.add_argument("--trace-requests",type=int,default=0)
    args=ap.parse_args()
    root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    entry=Path(sys.argv[0]).absolute()
    library=entry.with_suffix(".so") if entry.name.startswith("vllm_graph") and entry.suffix!=".py" else root/"build/vllm_graph.so"
    trace_path=Path(args.trace_output).resolve() if args.trace_output else None
    os.chdir(root)
    lib=ctypes.CDLL(str(library),mode=os.RTLD_LOCAL|os.RTLD_DEEPBIND)
    lib.max_tokens.restype=ctypes.c_uint;lib.max_requests.restype=ctypes.c_uint
    limit=lib.max_tokens();banks=lib.max_requests()
    assert os.environ.get("VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING")=="0","in-process bootstrap required for graph ownership"
    # The shared protocol owns eight slots, each at most prompt+output tokens.
    # Size their cache from the actual loaded upstream layer specs, including
    # the allocator's null block, before its ordinary initialization/profile.
    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu_worker import Worker
    from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import FullAttentionSpec
    original_memory=Worker.determine_available_memory
    def queue_memory(worker):
        specs=worker.get_kv_cache_spec()
        assert specs and all(type(spec) is FullAttentionSpec for spec in specs.values()),"full-attention cache required"
        block_sizes={spec.block_size for spec in specs.values()}
        assert len(block_sizes)==1,"uniform cache group required"
        needed_blocks=1+banks*math.ceil(2*limit/next(iter(block_sizes)))
        cache_bytes=needed_blocks*sum(spec.page_size_bytes for spec in specs.values())
        worker.cache_config.kv_cache_memory_bytes=cache_bytes
        print(json.dumps(dict(event="vllm_protocol_cache",context_tokens=2*limit,
            banks=banks,needed_blocks=needed_blocks,cache_bytes=cache_bytes,
            specs={name:dict(block_size=spec.block_size,page_size_bytes=spec.page_size_bytes)
                   for name,spec in specs.items()})),flush=True)
        return original_memory(worker)
    Worker.determine_available_memory=queue_memory
    try:
        llm=LLM(model=args.model,dtype="half",max_model_len=2*limit)
    finally:
        Worker.determine_available_memory=original_memory
    runner=llm.llm_engine.model_executor.driver_worker.worker.model_runner
    bt=runner.block_tables;buf=runner.input_buffers;config=runner.model_config.hf_config
    assert bt.num_kv_cache_groups==1 and bt.cp_size==1 and not runner.use_aux_hidden_state_outputs
    size=(limit+1)*banks;graphs={};managers=[];heads=[];selected=[]
    mapping=torch.arange(banks,dtype=torch.int32,device="cuda")
    temperatures=torch.zeros(banks,dtype=torch.float32,device="cuda")
    seeds=torch.zeros(banks,dtype=torch.int64,device="cuda")
    stream=torch.cuda.Stream()
    with torch.inference_mode():
        for query in range(1,limit+1):
            manager=ModelCudaGraphManager(runner.vllm_config,runner.device,
                CUDAGraphMode.FULL_AND_PIECEWISE,decode_query_len=query)
            manager._capture_descs={CUDAGraphMode.FULL:[
                BatchExecutionDescriptor(cg_mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL,num_tokens=query*batch,
                    num_reqs=batch,uniform_token_count=query)
                for batch in range(banks,0,-1)]}
            manager.capture(runner.model,runner.model_state,buf,runner.intermediate_tensors,
                bt,runner.attn_groups,runner.kv_cache_config,progress_bar_desc=f"Prefill query={query}")
            managers.append(manager)
            for batch in range(1,banks+1):
                desc=next(d for d in manager.graphs if d.num_reqs==batch)
                indices=torch.arange(query-1,query*batch,query,dtype=torch.int64,device="cuda")
                def sample():
                    hidden=manager.hidden_states[indices]
                    logits=runner.get_model().compute_logits(hidden)
                    return gumbel_sample(logits,mapping[:batch],temperatures,seeds,
                        buf.positions[indices],apply_temperature=False,is_drafting=False)

                with torch.cuda.stream(stream):warm=sample()
                stream.synchronize()

                with torch.cuda.graph(head,stream=stream,pool=manager.pool):output=sample()
                stream.synchronize()

                graphs[index]=(manager.graphs[desc],head,output,indices)
            print(f"captured vLLM query={query}/{limit} batches1..{banks}",flush=True)

    pool=llm.llm_engine.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.kv_cache_manager.block_pool

    blocks=pool.get_new_blocks(banks*blocks_per_request)

        rows=[[block.block_id*expansion+k
               for block in blocks[i*blocks_per_request:(i+1)*blocks_per_request]
               for k in range(expansion)] for i in range(banks)]
        pages=torch.tensor(rows,dtype=torch.int32,device="cuda")
        pointer_values=[buf.input_ids.data_ptr(),buf.positions.data_ptr(),buf.seq_lens.data_ptr(),
            buf.query_start_loc.data_ptr(),buf.is_padding.data_ptr(),bt.slot_mappings[0].data_ptr(),
            bt.input_block_tables[0].data_ptr(),pages.data_ptr()]
        emit=dict(event="vllm_bootstrap",model=args.model,block_sizes=bt.block_sizes,
            kernel_block_sizes=bt.kernel_block_sizes,pages=rows,graph_count=len(graphs),
            captured_batches=list(range(1,banks+1)),captured_queries=list(range(1,limit+1)))
        print(json.dumps(emit),flush=True)
        ptr=ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ulonglong)
        lib.serve.argtypes=[ptr,ptr,ptr,ptr]+[ctypes.c_uint]*8+[ctypes.c_char_p]
        lib.serve.restype=ctypes.c_int
        bodies=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*size)(*(graphs[i][0].raw_cuda_graph() for i in range(size)))
        head_raw=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*size)(*(graphs[i][1].raw_cuda_graph() for i in range(size)))
        outputs=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*size)(*(graphs[i][2].data_ptr() for i in range(size)))
        pointers=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*8)(*pointer_values)
        status=lib.serve(bodies,head_raw,outputs,pointers,bt.input_block_tables[0].stride(0),
            bt.kernel_block_sizes[0],pages.shape[1],config.vocab_size,config.num_hidden_layers,
            config.hidden_size,args.seconds,args.trace_requests,str(trace_path).encode() if trace_path else None)
        if status:raise RuntimeError(f"native serve failed: {status}")
        if trace_path:
            records=[json.loads(line) for line in trace_path.open()]
            assert records[-1]["event"]=="terminal" and records[-1]["overflows"]==0
            requests={};checked=0
            with trace_path.with_suffix(trace_path.suffix+".references.jsonl").open("w") as references,torch.inference_mode():
                for event in records:
                    if event["event"]=="admission":
                        bad=not(1<=event["query"]<=limit and 1<=event["gen"]<=limit) or any(token>=config.vocab_size for token in event["input_ids"])
                        assert bool(event["bad"])==bad,event
                        requests[event["id"]]=dict(prompt=event["input_ids"],gen=event["gen"],
                            bad=bad,client_ns=event["client_ns"],tokens=[])
                    elif event["event"]=="compute":
                        query=event["query"];batch=event["batch"];length=query or 1
                        ids=event["request_ids"];packed=[];positions=[];lens=[];slot_ids=[]
                        for row,request_id in enumerate(ids):
                            request=requests[request_id];assert not request["bad"]
                            prompt=request["prompt"];history=request["tokens"];physical=request_id%banks
                            if query:
                                assert not history and len(prompt)==query
                                values=prompt;pos=list(range(len(prompt)));seq=len(prompt)
                            else:
                                assert history and len(history)<request["gen"]
                                values=[history[-1]];pos=[len(prompt)+len(history)-1];seq=pos[0]+1
                            packed+=values;positions+=pos;lens.append(seq)
                            slots=[rows[physical][p//bt.kernel_block_sizes[0]]*bt.kernel_block_sizes[0]+p%bt.kernel_block_sizes[0] for p in pos]
                            slot_ids+=slots
                            bt.input_block_tables[0][row,:pages.shape[1]].copy_(pages[physical])
                        count=length*batch
                        buf.input_ids[:count].copy_(torch.tensor(packed,dtype=torch.int32,device="cuda"))
                        buf.positions[:count].copy_(torch.tensor(positions,dtype=torch.int64,device="cuda"))
                        buf.seq_lens[:batch].copy_(torch.tensor(lens,dtype=torch.int32,device="cuda"))
                        buf.query_start_loc[:batch+1].copy_(torch.arange(batch+1,dtype=torch.int32,device="cuda")*length)
                        buf.is_padding[:count].fill_(False)
                        bt.slot_mappings[0,:count].copy_(torch.tensor(slot_ids,dtype=torch.int64,device="cuda"))
                        index=query*banks+batch-1
                        body,head,output,indices=graphs[index];body.replay();head.replay()
                        actual=output.cpu().tolist()
                        assert actual==event["tokens"],(event,actual)
                        for request_id,token in zip(ids,actual):requests[request_id]["tokens"].append(token)
                        checked+=batch
                for request_id,request in requests.items():
                    assert request["bad"] or len(request["tokens"])==request["gen"],(request_id,request)
                    references.write(json.dumps(dict(id=request_id,**request))+"\n")
            print(json.dumps(dict(event="vllm_reference_replay",requests=len(requests),
                checked_tokens=checked,reference_file=str(trace_path)+".references.jsonl")),flush=True)
    finally:
        torch.cuda.synchronize();pool.free_blocks(blocks)
